base_art_style.name: Hyper-realistic cinematic product photography
base_art_style.description: Every image is a high-end commercial product photograph. The subject product is shot with a professional medium-format camera — tack-sharp focus, rich colour depth, physically accurate materials rendering. The environment surrounds it as a beautifully lit, out-of-focus scene rendered with cinematic realism. The effect: a real physical product sitting inside a real-feeling world.
base_art_style.photography_style: Commercial product photography. 85mm–135mm portrait/product lens equivalent. Shallow depth of field — the product is razor-sharp and in perfect focus. Everything behind it falls into creamy bokeh blur (f/1.8–f/2.8 equivalent). Bokeh balls from environmental light sources are visible as beautiful circular highlights in the background.
base_art_style.lighting: Studio-quality three-point lighting on the product: a key light from upper-left giving strong directional illumination, a fill light softening shadows, and a rim/backlight separating the product from the background. The key light colour temperature is influenced by the scene's atmosphere. Specular highlights on the product surface are crisp and well-defined.
base_art_style.product_surface: The product's physical surface materials are rendered with photographic accuracy — reflections, texture, sheen, and tactile quality are all visible. The product looks like something you could reach out and pick up.
base_art_style.background: The background environment is photographically real and cinematic — rendered at next-gen game engine quality (Unreal Engine 5 fidelity). It is heavily blurred with bokeh so visual attention stays entirely on the product. Key iconic elements of the environment remain recognisable through the blur.
base_art_style.depth_of_field: Extreme bokeh on the background. The product is perfectly sharp. Mid-ground elements (surfaces the product rests on) are slightly soft. Background elements are fully blurred into smooth bokeh circles. This depth-of-field separation is the defining visual effect of this style.
base_art_style.color_grading: Each image has a subtle cinematic colour grade matching the scene's mood. The product's own colours remain accurate and punchy despite the grade — the grade affects the background and lighting, not the product itself.
base_art_style.composition: Clean hero composition. The product is centred or slightly off-centre using the rule of thirds. It is large and dominates the frame. The background bokeh creates atmosphere without competing for attention. Generous, uncluttered framing.
base_art_style.what_never_changes: The product's physical appearance, materials, and labelling are identical in every image. It is always in perfect focus. It always looks like a premium commercial product shot. Only the background environment and lighting colour temperature change between variations.

products.name: FruityBurst Gummies

product_visual_spec.description: FruityBurst Gummies stand-up resealable pouch. Photographed with razor-sharp focus, high-gloss plastic surface, rich physical materials.
product_visual_spec.bag_shape: Tall stand-up resealable pouch, slightly wider at the bottom. Stands upright on a surface. The bag has realistic physical weight — it sags very slightly at the top near the resealable zip, full and plump with product inside.
product_visual_spec.bag_size: Medium snack-size sharing bag. In the frame it is large — roughly filling the center vertical third of the image so all label details are fully legible.
product_visual_spec.bag_material: High-gloss plastic film packaging. Surface shows crisp specular highlights from the lighting. You can see slight surface texture and the reflective sheen of commercial candy packaging. The edges of the bag catch rim light.
product_visual_spec.bag_base_color: Deep vivid cherry red (#FF2D2D) covering the majority of the front face. The red is rich and saturated — deepens to near-crimson (#CC1A1A) in the shadow areas on the sides and bottom. A broad specular highlight runs diagonally from upper-left center, showing the glossy plastic surface.
product_visual_spec.logo: The word 'FruityBurst' in large bold rounded bubble-letter font, bright metallic golden yellow (#FFD700) with a subtle embossed appearance — the letters have a slight raised look with a thin bright highlight along the top edge. Below it, 'GUMMIES' in clean bold white all-caps sans-serif with a very thin drop shadow.
product_visual_spec.logo_position: Centered on the upper 40% of the bag face. Always fully visible and legible.
product_visual_spec.fruit_illustration: 6-8 photorealistic-looking cartoon gummy candies rendered with translucency and gloss — red strawberry, yellow lemon, orange slice, green apple, purple grape, pink watermelon slice. They catch the light and look genuinely delicious and jewel-like. Arranged loosely across the center-lower area of the bag.
product_visual_spec.bottom_strip: Thick golden yellow (#FFD700) band at the bottom of the bag. Bold red text: 'REAL FRUIT FLAVORS • NO ARTIFICIAL COLORS'. Clean, professional label typography.
product_visual_spec.burst_badge: Top-right corner: bright yellow starburst badge with bold red text '12 FLAVORS'. High-contrast, clean.
product_visual_spec.reseal_strip: White frosted resealable zip strip across the top of the bag — shows realistic plastic translucency.
product_visual_spec.consistency_instruction: This bag must look physically identical in every single image. Same colors, same label, same proportions, same materials. It is always tack-sharp and in perfect focus. It always looks like a real physical product you could pick up off a shelf. Do not alter the bag's appearance to stylize it toward any game — the bag is always a real-world commercial product. Only the background, lighting temperature, and surface the bag rests on change between images.

products.visual_mood: Hyper-realistic commercial product photography. Sharp product, cinematic bokeh background, game world atmosphere.

gaming_themes.style: The bag sits on the iconic Fortnite LOOT LLAMA piñata — the brightly coloured blue-and-yellow llama figure with a rainbow saddle that is unmistakeably Fortnite. Background bokeh: the signature PURPLE STORM WALL — a churning, glowing wall of purple energy filling the entire background sky. In the midground bokeh, the iconic BATTLE BUS floats across the storm, the blue blimp with its yellow basket clearly visible. The sky transitions from the game's signature bright cartoon blue to deep electric purple where the storm meets the horizon. Scattered bokeh balls come from golden floor loot item glows on the ground. Lighting: warm golden-orange key light from the clean side, with cool electric purple rim light from the storm. This image must be instantly recognisable as Fortnite from the loot llama, storm wall, and battle bus alone.
gaming_themes.audience: competitive teen and young adult gamers
gaming_themes.message: Drop in. Snack up. Victory Royale fuel.

gaming_themes.style: The bag sits on a ROBLOX AVATAR FIGURE — the iconic blocky, low-poly Roblox character with its squared-off limbs, cylindrical head, and signature 'R' on the chest, rendered photorealistically as a plastic toy. Background bokeh: the Roblox game selection screen aesthetic — multiple floating colourful game-world thumbnail portals visible as blurred glowing rectangles in the background, each a different vivid primary colour. The sky is the classic ROBLOX BRIGHT BLUE with white block-shaped clouds. On the ground surface, the iconic ROBLOX LOGO in red block letters is partially visible, slightly blurred. Bokeh balls come from the bright coloured portal frames glowing around the edges. Lighting: cheerful bright high-key daylight, very clean and saturated — the signature Roblox look. This must be unmistakeably Roblox from the blocky avatar figure and portal thumbnails.
gaming_themes.audience: kids and young teens, creative builders
gaming_themes.message: Build your world. Fuel your imagination.

gaming_themes.style: The bag sits on a photorealistic Minecraft GRASS BLOCK — the iconic green-topped, brown dirt-sided cube with the distinctive pixelated grass texture, rendered with real material depth and shadow. A DIAMOND SWORD with its characteristic teal pixel-art blade leans against the bag, slightly blurred. Background bokeh: a Minecraft OVERWORLD scene — stacked block mountains, birch trees made of cube leaves, and a CREEPER face visible in the midground bokeh, its iconic four-pixel green face unmistakeable. The sky is Minecraft clear blue with the distinctive flat pixel-texture clouds. Bokeh balls come from floating XP ORBS — small green glowing spheres drifting near the ground. Lighting: clean warm Minecraft daytime sun from upper left. This is already the strongest theme — lean into the creeper face in background and XP orb bokeh.

The bag sits on a HEARTHSTONE — the iconic glowing blue-and-gold hearthstone from WoW, the magical stone that teleports players home, sitting on a wooden surface, its rune glowing warmly. Background bokeh: the unmistakeable STORMWIND CATHEDRAL — the towering gothic blue-and-gold stone spires of WoW's most iconic building, massively blurred into bokeh but the distinctive pointed spire silhouette clearly readable. A HORDE BANNER — red with the golden Horde symbol — hangs in the blurred background on the right side. In the background bokeh, two FACTION-SPECIFIC FLYING MOUNTS are silhouetted against a dramatic orange-purple sky. Bokeh balls come from ambient mana wisps — floating blue glowing orbs characteristic of WoW's magical environments. Lighting: rich warm amber torchlight as key light, cool blue mana-wisp rim light. Must be instantly readable as WoW from the Stormwind spires, Horde banner, and hearthstone.
gaming_themes.message: For the Horde. For the candy.

gaming_themes.style: The bag sits on the NEXUS CRYSTAL — the iconic glowing blue-white crystalline obelisk structure at the heart of Summoner's Rift, its magical energy radiating outward. Background bokeh: SUMMONER'S RIFT from a dramatic low angle — the three-lane map's iconic INHIBITOR TOWERS are visible as large glowing blue columns in the midground bokeh. A BARON NASHOR tentacle or glowing eye is faintly visible in the dark purple background bokeh. The entire scene is bathed in the signature LoL COLOR GRADE — deep forest green-to-black ground with electric blue and teal magical energy everywhere. Minimap-style circular UI elements are softly blurred in corner bokeh. Bokeh balls come from the Nexus crystal energy, inhibitor glow, and ambient spell particles. Lighting: cool electric teal-blue key light from the Nexus below, deep purple rim from the rift atmosphere. The LoL aesthetic — dark forest, magical blue structures, ominous purple — must be instantly recognisable.
gaming_themes.audience: competitive young adult gamers, esports fans
gaming_themes.message: Dominate the rift. Powered by FruityBurst.

gaming_themes.style: The bag sits on a RADIANITE CANISTER — the iconic glowing teal cylindrical container with the Valorant geometric diamond logo on it, a signature prop from every Valorant map. Background bokeh: the VALORANT AGENT SELECT SCREEN aesthetic — agent portrait silhouettes with their characteristic ability icons, blurred into soft glowing forms. The most recognisable element: SAGE'S HEALING ORB — a glowing teal sphere — floats near the bag, slightly blurred but clearly Valorant. The VALORANT LOGO — the V with the slash — is engraved on the floor surface beneath the bag, catching the teal light. Background shows the SPLIT MAP rooftops — red Japanese-inspired architecture with teal Radianite lighting — heavily blurred. Bokeh balls come from Radianite energy, Sage orbs, and ambient ability particles in teal and white. Lighting: stark cool-white key light, strong teal Radianite rim. Must read immediately as Valorant from the Radianite canister and teal-white color language.
gaming_themes.message: Clutch the round. Clutch the bag.

gaming_themes.style: The bag sits on an APEX LEGENDS CARE PACKAGE — the iconic red-and-silver drop pod with flashing orange lights that falls from the sky delivering legendary loot, a universally recognised Apex prop. Background bokeh: KINGS CANYON at sunset — the iconic SKULLTOWN skull-shaped ruins are visible as a massive silhouette in the background bokeh, the giant hollow skull unmistakeable. The APEX LEGENDS JUMPMASTER COMPASS UI — the circular squad icon display — glows in the upper corner bokeh. The SKY is an extreme sunset: bright orange-to-magenta-to-deep-purple, with the distinctive Apex silhouetted clifftops. Bokeh balls come from the care package beacon light, distant squad beacon pings (blue), and fire particles. Lighting: dramatic warm orange key from the sunset, cool purple atmospheric rim. Must be instantly readable as Apex Legends from the Care Package and Skulltown skull silhouette.
gaming_themes.audience: action gamers, diverse young adult audience

gaming_themes.style: The bag sits on a KILLSTREAK CARE PACKAGE — the iconic dark olive-green military crate with the orange parachute still attached and the red flare beacon blinking, the most recognisable prop in CoD multiplayer history. Background bokeh: NUKETOWN — the iconic CoD map with its signature two NUCLEAR FAMILY MANNEQUINS visible as blurred silhouettes in front of the 1950s houses, the suburban American street layout clearly readable. The NUCLEAR BOMB PROP — the classic yellow atomic bomb on a trolley from Nuketown — is faintly visible in the background bokeh. The sky is post-strike: grey-orange, with a mushroom cloud shape forming in the far background bokeh. Bokeh balls come from the care package beacon, tracer fire streaks, and distant explosion light. Lighting: cold grey overcast key light, warm orange fire rim light from off-screen. Must be instantly recognisable as CoD from the Killstreak care package and Nuketown mannequins.
gaming_themes.audience: older teen and adult gamers, military game fans
gaming_themes.message: Stay in the fight. Stay fueled.

gaming_themes.style: The bag sits on THE SKELD CAFETERIA TABLE — the iconic rounded rectangular table with the signature AMONG US RED CREWMATE sitting next to the bag, its bean-shaped body, backpack, and visor unmistakeable, rendered as a cute 3D figure. A DEAD CREWMATE — the iconic ghost with its tongue sticking out — floats translucently nearby. Background bokeh: THE SKELD spaceship interior — the distinctive ROUNDED RECTANGULAR DOOR FRAMES with their glowing yellow-orange outlines, the EMERGENCY BUTTON — a large red button labelled EMERGENCY on a pedestal — visible in the midground. REACTOR CORE pipes and the signature teal-walled corridors are blurred behind. Bokeh balls come from the glowing door frames, emergency button, and ambient ship lighting. Lighting: warm white overhead cafeteria light, slight red emergency-alert tint from the right. Must be unmistakeably Among Us from the crewmate figure, ghost, and emergency button.
gaming_themes.audience: casual gamers, all ages, social gaming crowd

gaming_themes.style: The bag sits on the grass next to a POKE BALL — the iconic red-and-white sphere with the central button, photorealistically rendered as a glossy plastic object. A PIKACHU — rendered as a photorealistic plush or figure — sits on the other side of the bag, its bright yellow fur, red cheek spots, and zigzag tail clearly visible but slightly soft. Background bokeh: PALLET TOWN — the iconic starting town with its small houses and PROFESSOR OAK'S LABORATORY, the large building with its distinctive antenna silhouetted in the background bokeh. The POKEDEX — the iconic red flip device — sits on the surface nearby, partially open, screen glowing. Bokeh balls come from POKEMON SPARKLE EFFECTS — the characteristic four-pointed star sparkles that appear when Pokemon are encountered, scattered through the background. Lighting: warm golden afternoon sunlight, soft adventure-film lens flare from upper right. Must be unmistakeably Pokemon from Pikachu, the Poke Ball, Pokedex, and sparkle effects.
gaming_themes.audience: all ages, nostalgic fans and new players
